sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Happy Color Sort Puzzle' is a water sort puzzle game where you're tasked with sorting different colors of water into their respective containers. The game starts with a series of containers with different colors of water, and your objective is to sort the water into the correct containers. Sounds simple right? Well, it's not as easy as it sounds. The colors all look remarkably similar, making it a challenging task to sort them correctly.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. You can move a container to a new position by clicking and dragging it, and you can also swap the water between two containers by clicking on them. The game also has a hint system that provides you with subtle clues to help you solve the puzzle. However, be careful not to rely too heavily on the hints, as they can give away the solution to the puzzle.

One of the unique features of 'Happy Color Sort Puzzle' is its use of different water colors and patterns. The game features a variety of colors, from bright blues and greens to deep purples and pinks. Each container is also filled with a unique pattern of water droplets, which makes it even more challenging to sort the water correctly. The game also features a variety of level designs, from simple to complex, which adds to the game's replay value.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
If you're new to 'Happy Color Sort Puzzle', here are some beginner tips and tricks to help you get started. Firstly, it's essential to understand the game's basic mechanics, which include moving a container to a new position and swapping the water between two containers. Practice these basic mechanics to get a feel for the game, and then move on to the more challenging levels.

Another tip is to focus on one color at a time. Sort the water into the correct containers one color at a time, rather than trying to tackle all the colors at once. This will make the game much more manageable, and you'll be able to complete the levels more efficiently.

Finally, use the hint system sparingly. While the hint system can be helpful, it can also give away the solution to the puzzle. Use it only when you're stuck, and try to solve the puzzle on your own first.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter more challenging levels that require advanced strategies to complete. Here are some tips and tricks to help you tackle these levels.

One advanced strategy is to use the container's size to your advantage. If you have a container that's larger than the others, try to use it to hold multiple colors of water. This will give you more flexibility when sorting the water, and you'll be able to complete the levels more efficiently.

Another advanced strategy is to use the water's flow to your advantage. The water flows from one container to another, and you can use this to your advantage by moving the containers in the right order. Experiment with different container movements to see how the water flows, and use it to your advantage to complete the levels.
